'''Kenosha''' was an object<ref name="RF" /> located in the [[Tynna sector/Legends|Tynna sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Kenosha was known for its breathtaking cliffs.<ref name="RF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kenosha was first mentioned<ref name="RF" /> in the novel ''[[Rebel Force: Trapped]]'', which was written by [[Alex Wheeler]] and released in [[2010]].<ref name="ERC" /> Kenosha was first mentioned<ref name="RF" /> in the novel ''[[Rebel Force: Trapped]]'', which was written by [[Alex Wheeler]] and released in [[2010]].<ref name="ERC" /> Later, the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the [[Kenosha system/Legends|Kenosha star system]], and thereby Kenosha itself, in grid square N-14.<ref name="EAOC" />
